pyramiding_rule: Absolute ban on sequential scaling into the same directional leg within a 120-second rolling window to prevent correlated liquidation loops.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory multi-timeframe ATR volatility envelope validation; entries prohibited if current candle spread exceeds 2.5x 20-period moving average ATR.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing profit locks at +$4.00 to prevent green evaporation, scaling out 50% of volume at +$10.00 and trailing the remainder toward a +$20.00 to +$30.00 target.
